Projects.Name: Aspire.Hosting.AWS
ChangelogMessages: Update to Aspire 17. Aspire.Hosting.AWS now targets net10.0 only, matching the .NET 10 minimum of Aspire 17, and depends on Aspire 17 packages

Add DotnetProjectResource (AddDotnetProject) support alongside the existing ProjectResource APIs: an AddAgentCoreRuntime overload that takes a project path, DotnetProjectResource overloads of WithAgentCoreStreaming, WithAgentCoreMemory, PublishAsECSFargateService, PublishAsECSFargateServiceWithALB, PublishAsECSFargateExpressService and PublishAsAgentCoreRuntime, and an IResource overload on ITarballContainerImageBuilder

Fix publish and deploy failing for Aspire parameters marked optional with AsOptional: the generated CloudFormation parameter now has an empty default, so the deploy step no longer requires a value for it

Use the default an AppHost defines for an Aspire parameter (for example AddParameter with publishValueAsDefault) as the default of the generated CloudFormation parameter, so deploying without configuring the parameter uses it. Generated and secret defaults are not written to the template
Update Amazon.CDK.Lib to 2.278.0 and the AWS SDK for .NET dependencies to 4.1. Deployment now requires AWS CDK CLI 2.1148.2 or later

Fix the ECS Fargate Express Service endpoint URL having a duplicated https:// scheme, in both the deployment output and the service-discovery environment variable given to resources that reference the service
